Ensure all buttons (hero CTA, navbar CTA, contact form submit, gallery CTA, floating button) use #0284C7.
Add responsive navigation and a full interactive WhatsApp lead generator form that constructs pre-filled WhatsApp message URLs to wa.me/5527998682220.
Include Google Maps iframe for location R. Vitória, 488 - Alterosas, Serra - ES.
Make sure data-testid attributes are present on every key element.
